Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

jobs.employer_name: ZOE Institute for Future-Fit Economies gUG
jobs.description:
Who we are

ZOE, the Institute for Future-Fit Economies, is an independent think & do tank active in Germany and in Brussels . We are dedicated to policy-oriented research and evidence-driven advocacy for a futurefit economy. At the interface of politics, research, and civil society in the EU, we develop impulses for an economy that enables people to live well within planetary boundaries.

We offer:

- A motivating working environment in a small think & do tank that has become an established actor in Brussels in a short space of time
- A strategic, agile, value and purpose-oriented working style
- Flexibility of working time and place, supporting a healthy work-life-balance

The role

The Economics of a Green and Just Transition team is seeking a trainee to support policy and research work across several projects related to financing and implementing a green and just transition. The trainee will help develop content and analytical materials, contribute to EU-level policy analysis, and may also support an industry-focused project with a particular emphasis on Germany.

Key responsibilities

As part of a motivated and impact-driven team you will carry out a variety of tasks, including: − Background research and analysis on various topics

- Drafting content for reports, policy briefs and other publications
- Preparation of presentations and key documents
- Preparing briefings for key stakeholder meetings
- Support in monitoring of current economic policy events and debates
- Support in the organization of events (physical and online)

Core competences

We are looking for people that share our core principles: value orientation, sustainability, agility, selforganisation .

Your profile would include the following skills, background , and knowledge:

- Excellent command of English and German , both oral and written -
- Master’s degree in economics/ political economy /European studies /public policy
- Interest in economic policy topics like fiscal policy and industrial policy
- Ability to work independently and in teams
- Strong analytical skills
- Strategic mindset

In addition, some of the following competencies fit well into our team but are not a requirement: -

- Knowledge of legislative processes in the EU and/or Germany
- Qualitative and/or quantitative research skills
- Based in Brussels or Berlin

Conditions

We are looking for someone to join our team for 38 hours per week for 6 months. The position will start ideally in October 2026. We offer the possibility to work remotely from Germany , the Netherlands, or Belgium or to work from our offices in Cologne, Berlin, and Brussels.

The gross monthly salary for full-time is 2289 euros, prorated for fewer hours. The remuneration for this position is based on our internal salary framework, informed by the collective agreement of the public service of the Länder. For a full-time (38 hours) position, 30 holiday days are offered for one calendar year.

In addition to this, ZOE offers several benefits such as additional days off for volunteering and reimbursement for public transportation.

Diversity

We believe that our society’s behaviour disproportionately hurts the most marginali sed people – including people of colour, people from working class backgrounds, people with disabilities, women and LGBTIQ people. We are committed to challenge this through our work for socially just development and by creating a diverse workplace at our organisation . Hence, we strongly encourage applications from people who are members of marginali sed communities.

Application procedure

Please send your applications by 30 August. Please send : a) your CV (max 3 pages), b) a motivation letter (400–500 words) explaining why you would like to work with ZOE Institute and c) a sample of your work (power point slides, publication, press release or similar) to applications@zoe-institut.de. Please do not attach a photo to your application. Please state “Economic Policy Trainee” in the subject line.
If we shortlist you for an interview, we will get back to you as soon as possible with dates for an online interview. In case of any questions please contact applications@zoe-institut.de. Thank you very much for your interest in ZOE Institute .

jobs.occupation: Operations Coordinator - Dutch & German speaking m/f/d (Callcenteragent/in)
jobs.description:
**Location:**  Ghent

Client confidential

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future? If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. 

This is us, your new colleagues

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.

This is the job

- Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind.
- Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress.
- A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box.
- Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business 

Are you the one?

- You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers.
- You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported.
- You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset.
- You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up.
- You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills.
- You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients.
- You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German.

A perfect match? Just some of the benefits working for us...

- Competitive salary, with meal vouchers, transport costs, shift allowance, etc.
- Well-being services
- Restaurant on site
- Opportunity to grow within the company
- Good work life balance
- International environment
- Support in relocation when moving from abroad

Your occupation involves manufacturing custom-made ceramic pots in various shapes and sizes, with a strong focus on handmade craftsmanship. 
The process is completely tailored, meaning you don't keep stock, and each piece is unique. Y
our production method involves using clay slabs placed into plaster moulds, which shape each pot.

Your workday highlights:

• You work in a bright, spacious workshop with colleagues who share a passion for craftsmanship.
• Each day, you start fresh, handling large amounts of clay (around 30 kilos) to begin shaping new pots.
• The work culture emphasizes dedication, teamwork, and passion for creating high-quality, unique products.
• Your day starts at 8 am and wraps up at 4:30 pm, leaving you with a sense of satisfaction from having created something that could eventually end up in places like Dubai or New York.
• No previous experience is required, as talent and motivation are valued over formal experience.
Sounds like a fulfilling environment where creativity and hard work are key!

This job offers an exciting opportunity to work in a creative production environment where you can engage in physical, hands-on work. Here's what the role entails:

• You'll be working with your hands, building large ceramic pots manually, with each slab of clay weighing around 15 kg—think of it as free fitness while earning a salary.
• The working language is English, and you'll be part of a multicultural team. While strong verbal communication in English is required, reading and writing skills are not necessary.
• You're looking for a permanent job and are eager to learn. No prior experience is required, as you'll receive comprehensive training over 4-6 months, learning everything from A to Z.
• The role requires motivation, attention to quality, and a strong work ethic. You'll be part of a small team where each person plays a crucial role in the production process.
In this position, you'll not only contribute to creating unique products but also work in a dynamic and supportive team, making a real impact every day.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a versatile CE driver & warehouse worker (M/F/X) to join the team of a well-known employer in Zaventem. In addition to driving the lorry between the two warehouses (distance of approximately 12 kilometres), you will also work as a warehouse worker and be deployed in a multifunctional role.
 

Performing the job correctly contributes to good results and a stronger team. That is why flexibility, eagerness to learn, common sense and stress resistance are essential. Do you have an ETP certificate or a forklift certificate? That is a plus, but not a requirement.

 

• You are stress-resistant, accurate and able to stay focused. 

• You are a team player. 

• You are flexible and motivated. 

• You are fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch is a plus! 

• You can easily travel to work. 

• You have the ability to work in a rotating two-shift system. 

• You have a CE driving licence.

About the role

This SAP position centers on production-driven processes in a manufacturing setting, with a clear focus on SAP PE, QM and PPDS.

You take the lead in and support end-to-end SAP implementations, covering fit-gap analysis, system configuration, functional design documentation, training, UAT, data gathering and migration, go-live support, and final documentation. In this role, you work closely with logistics, controlling, procurement and other business domains to secure smooth SAP integration across domains.

You collaborate proactively with cross-functional stakeholders and production team members to shape detailed, scalable and sustainable processes. This assignment calls for someone who can grasp complex business flows, challenge stakeholders to clarify their real needs, and translate those requirements into structured SAP solutions in both template-based and custom-built environments.

You also support business users through clear communication, maintain alignment between domains, and contribute to successful deployment activities in an international environment.

Key responsibilities

• Lead and support SAP delivery across the full implementation lifecycle, from analysis through go-live and documentation.
• Design and optimize production-related SAP processes within a manufacturing environment.
• Translate business needs into robust functional solutions across connected SAP domains.
• Work with stakeholders across logistics, controlling, procurement and production to ensure process consistency and integration.
• Support deployment activities, including additional travel where needed around go-live periods.
Project scope

• Production Execution (PE): strong expertise in SAP PE processes in a manufacturing context, including shop floor integration and execution flows.
• Quality Management (QM): solid experience in SAP QM, ideally combined with integration with Labvantage or a comparable LIMS platform.
• PPDS: good understanding of Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling, with the ability to connect planning and execution processes.
• Experience with EWM integration is an advantage.
• Experience in greenfield implementations is a plus.
Work environment

You work in an international, multicultural setting with regular on-site presence in Hoboken and travel when required, including possible additional travel during go-live phases.

• Proven experience with end-to-end SAP implementations.
• Strong expertise in SAP integration across domains, including logistics, controlling and procurement.
• Hands-on experience with SAP PE, QM and PPDS in a manufacturing company.
• PPDS knowledge is preferred but not mandatory.
• Familiarity with integration with Labvantage or a similar LIMS platform, and preferably EWM.
• Ability to debug and troubleshoot SAP issues is a plus.
• You communicate clearly, in a structured and business-oriented way, and can explain complex solutions in a simple manner to stakeholders.
• You are comfortable challenging the business to uncover the underlying requirements.
• You collaborate effectively with both business stakeholders and technical colleagues and build strong working relationships.
• You demonstrate a proactive mindset, resilience under pressure and flexibility when priorities shift.
• You are willing to be on site in Hoboken every week.
• You are fluent in English.
• Good French is required to support project activities for the Grenoble deployment.
• Polish is a plus.
• A bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• SAP certification is an asset, but hands-on experience is considered more important.
